title: Beginner in stocks and trading investment, and joined various communities
author: Background_Value4526
selftext:
Hey people, I have recently joined this community and many others in the hope of understanding stocks and trading and where and when I should invest money.   
I have also recently learned that there are various AI platforms and screeners that can help me get better information. can you suggest some good platforms that I can try out?

comments.author: Due_Tree_3959
comments.body: If you’re just getting started you will need to experiment with a variety of strategies and techniques until you can identify where your edge is. It took me years to learn HOW to develop an edge. Good luck to you. If you check out YouTube I think the free stuff from SMB Capital is a great place to start.

comments.author: Amir-trades
comments.body: TradingView for charting and Finviz for screening are solid starting points. Don't rely on AI to generate trades for you—use it to speed up data collection, backtesting setups, or building tools that automate your risk management rules.
